integrity: The exact metadata date 2014-03-27 is the first-public arXiv date of the inspected Kincaid-Oldham-Yu OLD-set source. The earlier Seo-Slater introduction was found only with February 2010 month-level public-date evidence, so no day was invented. Primary MSC 05C69 is independently recorded for archive-era OLD-set literature and appears as the sole MSC on the inspected Chellali-Jafari Rad-Seo-Slater paper.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for \(n\ge3\) and ordinary open-neighborhood locating-dominating sets. The \(n=3\) scalar boundary is a cycle case and may be covered by cycle-specific literature; the retained contribution is the uniform all-set characterization and enumerator. Exhaustive verification is finite, for \(3\le n\le8\), and is only a stress test.
title: All open-locating-dominating sets of crown graphs
